51697-grace-harlowe-with-the-american-ar.title: American Army on the Rhine
51697-grace-harlowe-with-the-american-ar.creator: Jessie Graham Flower, A.M.
51697-grace-harlowe-with-the-american-ar.description: A book by Jessie Graham Flower, A.M.. “Ridiculous!” exclaims General Gordon. Grace lays down the law to Mrs. “My orders are that you get out of my sight instantly!” CHAPTER VI--MESSING WITH A BRIGADIER 64 Overton girls left to walk. The general is not deceived. An invitation to visit cloudland. “Captain” Grace gives the intelligence officer some real intelligence.

arxiv-2004-14116.title: Measurements of Single Event Upset in ATLAS IBL
arxiv-2004-14116.creator: and M. Wensing
arxiv-2004-14116.description: Abstract Effects of Single Event Upsets (SEU) and Single Event Transients (SET) are studied in the FE-I4B chip of the innermost layer of the ATLAS pixel system. SEU/SET affect the FE-I4B Global Registers as well as the settings for the individual pixels, causing, among other things, occupancy losses, drops in the low voltage currents, noisy pixels, and silent pixels.

arxiv-2109-05118.title: Discretization of Annular-Ring Diffraction Pattern for Large-Scale Photonics Beamforming Journal: osajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2109-05118.creator: Aroutin Khachaturian \authormark *, Reza Fatemi, Artsroun Darbinian, and Ali Hajimiri
arxiv-2109-05118.description: Abstract A solid-state active beamformer based on the annular-ring diffraction pattern is proposed for an integrated photonic platform. Such a circularly symmetric annular-ring aperture achieves radiating element limited FOV. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that a multi-annular-ring aperture with a fixed linear density of elements maintains the beam efficiency for larger apertures while reducing the beamwidth and side-lobe-level (SLL).

arxiv-2111-02105.title: Legendre pairs of lengths ℓ ≡ 0 ​ ( mod ​ 5 ) \ell\equiv 0\,\,(\mathrm{mod}\;5) Thanks: West Virginia University Morgantown, West Virginia 26506, USA
arxiv-2111-02105.creator: Ilias Kotsireas Christoph Koutschan Dursun Bulutoglu
arxiv-2111-02105.description: Abstract By assuming a type of balance for length ℓ = 87 \ell=87 and non-trivial subgroups of multiplier groups of Legendre pairs (LPs) for length ℓ = 85 \ell=85 , we find LPs of these lengths. We then study the power spectral density (PSD) values of m m compressions of LPs of length 5 ​ m 5m .

arxiv-2205-14951.title: Benchmarking the Robustness of LiDAR-Camera Fusion for 3D Object Detection
arxiv-2205-14951.creator: Kaicheng Yu, Tang Tao, Hongwei Xie, Zhiwei Lin, Zhongwei Wu, Zhongyu Xia, Tingting Liang, Haiyang Sun, Jiong Deng, Dayang Hao, Yongtao Wang, Xiaodan Liang, Bing Wang
arxiv-2205-14951.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kaicheng Yu, Tang Tao, Hongwei Xie, Zhiwei Lin, Zhongwei Wu, Zhongyu Xia, Tingting Liang, Haiyang Sun, Jiong Deng, Dayang Hao, Yongtao Wang, Xiaodan Liang, Bing Wang. There are two critical sensors for 3D perception in autonomous driving, the camera and the LiDAR. The camera provides rich semantic information such as color, texture, and the LiDAR reflects the 3D shape and locations of surrounding objects.

arxiv-2210-03409.title: The dipole formalism for massive initial-state particles and its application to dark matter calculations Preprint: MS-TP-22-09, MITP-22-078
arxiv-2210-03409.creator: J. Harz, M. Klasen, M.Y. Sassi, L.P. Wiggering
arxiv-2210-03409.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by J. Harz, M. Klasen, M.Y. Sassi, L.P. Wiggering. The dark matter abundance plays a crucial role in the determination of the valid parameter space of models both in the case of a discovery of dark matter and in the context of exclusion limits. Reliable theoretical predictions of the dark matter relic density require technically demanding precision calculations, which were so far limited in their automation due to challenges in the treatment of infrared divergences appearing in higher order calculations.

arxiv-2407-03681.title: HyperSpace: Hypernetworks for spacing-adaptive image segmentation
arxiv-2407-03681.creator: Samuel Joutard, Maximilian Pietsch, Raphael Prevost
arxiv-2407-03681.description: Abstract Medical images are often acquired in different settings, requiring harmonization to adapt to the operating point of algorithms. Specifically, to standardize the physical spacing of imaging voxels in heterogeneous inference settings, images are typically resampled before being processed by deep learning models. However, down-sampling results in loss of information, whereas upsampling introduces redundant information leading to inefficient resource utilization.

arxiv-2503-16336.title: A parallel algorithm for the odd two-face shortest k k -disjoint path problem
arxiv-2503-16336.creator: Srijan Chakraborty, Samir Datta
arxiv-2503-16336.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Srijan Chakraborty, Samir Datta. The shortest Disjoint Path problem ( 𝖲𝖣𝖯𝖯 {\mathsf{SDPP}} ) requires us to find pairwise vertex disjoint paths between k k designated pairs of terminal vertices such that the sum of the path lengths is minimum. The focus here is on 𝖲𝖣𝖯𝖯 {\mathsf{SDPP}} restricted to planar graphs where all terminals are arbitrarily partitioned over two distinct faces with the additional restriction that each face is required to contain an odd number of terminals.

arxiv-2603-27003.creator: Tanmay Mukherjee, Neil Gautam, Nikhil Kadivar, Elizabeth M. Fugate, Kyle J. Myers, Diana Lindquist, Pierre Croisille, Sakthivel Sadayappan, Patrick Clarysse, Jacques Ohayon, Roderic Pettigrew, George Karniadakis, Reza Avazmohammadi

pmc-10793620.title: An elevated systemic inflammation index is related to an inferior response to pomalidomide and dexamethasone treatment in patients with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma
pmc-10793620.creator: Damian Mikulski, Paweł Robak, Grzegorz Mirocha, Wiktoria Ryżewska, Kamila Stańczak, Karol Okoński, Kacper Kościelny, Tadeusz Robak
pmc-10793620.description: IntroductionThe systemic inflammation index (SII) might serve as an indicator of the equilibrium between the inflammatory and immune responses. The aim of the study was to determine the clinical value and prognostic significance of SII in the cohort of multiple myeloma (MM) patients treated with a regimen of pomalidomide and dexamethasone (Pd).

pmc-11795502.title: Molecular docking and simulation analysis of c-KIT and PDGFRα with phytochemicals as dual inhibitors for GIST
pmc-11795502.creator: Kaoutar El Khattabi, Sanaa Lemriss, Rachid El Jaoudi, Fouad Zouaidia
pmc-11795502.description: Mutations in the c-KIT or PDGFRα genes primarily drive gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs). While tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) such as Imatinib have improved outcomes, resistance due to secondary mutations remains a significant challenge. This study used computational methods to identify phytochemicals from Moroccan plants as dual inhibitors of c-KIT and PDGFRα.

pmc-12442922.title: α-ALA Attenuates Cardiac Injury in Diabetic Heart Disease Mice by Modulating Inflammation and AMPKα1
pmc-12442922.creator: Xuan Liu, Landi Wang, Weiwei Dong, Yuchao Wang, Dayong Li
pmc-12442922.description: IntroductionDiabetic heart disease (DHD) is systolic and/or diastolic dysfunction of the heart muscle that occurs in patients with the presence of Type 2 diabetes mellitus. AMPKα1, a key regulator of glucose metabolism, has been shown to promote glucose uptake and catabolism.

pmc-12616037.title: Nasal respiration modulates pain perception via the olfactory Bulb–Anterior cingulate cortex circuit
pmc-12616037.creator: Ruixue Cheng, Yuxue Wang, Chunyan Dou, Song Gu, Weixiang Tang, Chen Chen, Ke Chen, Shuai Cui, Weiwei Zhong
pmc-12616037.description: SummaryBreath regulation has been shown to reduce pain and anxiety-like emotions in humans, but the underlying neural mechanisms are still unclear. Here, we demonstrate that nasal respiratory sensory deprivation (Triton X-100) reduces the respiration-entrained rhythm (RR) transmitted from the olfactory bulb (OB) to the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), ultimately exerting an antinociceptive effect in a mouse model of neuropathic pain.

pmc-12633713.title: Preliminary report: The most considerable outbreak of Legionnaires' disease in France in the last two decades, Albertville, September 2025
pmc-12633713.creator: Emmanuelle Vaissière, Audrey Merlet, Muriel Deher, Matthieu Curtil-Dit-Galin, Jean-Marc Yvon, Albane Beaupoil, Emmanuel Forestier, Jean-Marie Kuntzelmann, Brune Joannard, Aymeric Provost, Guillaume Spaccaferri, Christelle Nolibos, Laetitia Beraud, Nathalie Grangeret, Christine Campese, Sophie Jarrau
pmc-12633713.description: In September 2025, 50 laboratory-confirmed cases of Legionnaires’ disease (LD) were identified in Albertville, in south-eastern France. Initially, 23 patients were only clinically diagnosed and only confirmed later due to limited sensitivity of the urinary antigen screening test used. All cases occurred within 12 days, suggesting a common point source of massive contamination.

pmc-12750599.title: Intersecting burdens: oral health, dietary patterns, food security and their impact on cardiometabolic risk and mental health in Ghana
pmc-12750599.creator: Fiifi Amoako A P Essiam, Mary Amoako, Emmanuel Kwadwo Owusu, Evans Ogura, Eunice Akosua Serwaa Hammond, Ibrahim Ahmed Tijani, Fredrick Asenso Wireko, Lord Jephthah Joojo Gowans
pmc-12750599.description: BackgroundThe nutrition transition and persistent food insecurity in Ghana and similar low- and middle-income countries pose significant challenges to both physical and mental health. Emerging evidence suggests that oral health may be implicated in these associations. This study examines the associations between oral health, dietary patterns, food insecurity and their associations with cardiometabolic and psychological distress outcomes.

pmc-12798403.title: Exploring pathways to compulsory detention in psychiatric hospital and ways to prevent repeat detentions; Service user perspectives
pmc-12798403.creator: Mary Birken, Ariana Kular, Patrick Nyikavaranda, Jordan Parkinson, Lizzie Mitchell, Kathleen Lindsay Fraser, Valerie Christina White, Janet Seale, Jackie Hardy, Cady Stone, Mark Keith Holden, Tyler Elliot, Zishi Li, Henrietta Mbeah-Bankas, Lisa Wood, Fiona Lobban, Brynmor Lloyd-Evans, Sonia Johnson
pmc-12798403.description: This study, co-produced by a team of academics, lived experience researchers and clinicians, explores the views and experiences of people who have been compulsorily detained in hospital under the Mental Health Act (1983) (MHA) in England, to understand how and why, from their perspective, compulsory detentions occur, and what might help prevent them.

pmc-13009254.title: Association between TNF-α polymorphisms and responsiveness to TNF-α blockers in ankylosing spondylitis and psoriatic arthritis: a meta-analysis
pmc-13009254.creator: Young Ho Lee, Gwan Gyu Song
pmc-13009254.description: To investigate the association between tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) polymorphisms and the responsiveness to anti-TNF-α therapy in patients with ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and psoriatic arthritis (PsA). A comprehensive literature search of the PubMed/Medline, Embase, and Web of Science databases was performed to identify relevant published studies.

pmc-13247742.title: Social Support and Hospital Discharge Readiness in CHD Patients: Mediating Roles of Self-Efficacy and Adherence
pmc-13247742.creator: Dandan Wang, Na Yang, Cheng Wei, Jingwen Wang, Liping Yuan, Ruixiang Sun
pmc-13247742.description: ObjectiveTo explore the associations among social support, self-efficacy, medication adherence, and discharge readiness in patients with coronary heart disease (CHD), specifically examining the mediating roles of self-efficacy and medication adherence.MethodsParticipants included 463 patients with coronary heart disease (CHD) recruited from a tertiary hospital in Wuhu City (February–June 2025) via convenience sampling.

pmc-13347327.title: Design and Synthesis of Novel Chalcogen-1,2,4-triazoles as Lead-like Glutathione Peroxidase-Mimetic Antioxidants
pmc-13347327.creator: Nathália L. B. Santos, Luana S. Gomes, Nathalia B. Sá, Pâmella Cordeiro, Aldo S. de Oliveira, Vanessa Nascimento
pmc-13347327.description: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) play essential roles in cellular signaling; however, their dysregulation leads to oxidative stress associated with several chronic diseases. Organoselenium compounds, particularly selenocyanates, exhibit glutathione peroxidase (GPx)-mimetic activity, while the 1,2,4-triazole scaffold is a privileged pharmacophore in medicinal chemistry.

pmc-13443209.title: A High-resolution metal–insulator–metal plasmonic biosensor with concentric ring resonators for carcinoembryonic antigen detection
pmc-13443209.creator: Hamid Bahador, Hadi Izadiyar, Azadeh Nilghaz
pmc-13443209.description: High-resolution optical sensors are vital for detecting subtle refractive index variations associated with biomolecular interactions, such as changes in carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) concentration. This work presents a compact metal–insulator–metal (MIM) plasmonic sensor with two concentric ring resonators, numerically investigated using finite-difference time-domain simulations.

pmc-13627025.title: Robust information transfer calculation reveals dynamic networks during sleep arousal
pmc-13627025.creator: Richard Hohmuth, Jakob J. Müller, Hagen Malberg, Martin Schmidt
pmc-13627025.description: Understanding the influence of cardiovascular diseases (CVD) on human regulatory functions is a major challenge in modern healthcare. This study explores whether the autonomic response to sleep arousals can serve as a diagnostic marker of the health of physiological networks.
